segments.vo: Imagine every agent giving you answers you can trust!

segments.vo: Here's the magic behind it. First, the agents: today's, and every new one coming.
They all ask one shared retrieval layer: reusable, safe, traceable and relevant, with rules that check every answer.
Underneath, one set of governance rules keeps every knowledge source accurate and up to date.
Ask a question, and it flows down, finds the right source, and comes right back, with proof!
Building a new agent? Easy! Register it, plug in, and inherit every rule. You're live from day one!
Every agent. One trusted knowledge foundation!
